dependency_edge.note: Presence-at-hand emerges from breakdown of readiness-to-hand (§16)

conflict_edge.note: Two fundamentally different modes of Being for entities within-the-world

tension_description: Readiness-to-hand is ontologically prior, yet presence-at-hand is what the tradition takes as the default mode of Being. The contrast is both structural and critical.

dependency_edge.note: Authenticity is a modification of das Man, not its opposite (§27)

conflict_edge.note: Authentic self-choice vs. dispersal in the 'they'

tension_description: Das Man is a necessary existentiale, yet authenticity requires wresting oneself from it. Dependence + opposition = productive tension.

dependency_edge.note: Falling belongs to the constitution of disclosedness (§38)

conflict_edge.note: Falling closes off what disclosedness opens up

tension_description: Disclosedness is Dasein's 'there,' but falling is equally constitutive and works against disclosure. The 'there' both reveals and conceals.

dependency_edge.note: Temporality is the ontological meaning of care (§65)

conflict_edge.note: Temporality transforms the meaning of care from structural whole to ecstatic unity

tension_description: Care is the being of Dasein (Division One), but temporality reinterprets it at a deeper level (Division Two). The 'same' structure shifts meaning.

dependency_edge.note: Death analysis begins from the death of Others as point of access (§47)

conflict_edge.note: Death is ownmost, non-relational — radically individualizing (§53)

tension_description: Death individualizes absolutely, yet Dasein is essentially Being-with. The tension between radical singularity and constitutive sociality is never fully resolved.

dependency_edge.note: Within-time-ness derives from originary temporality through levelling-off (§§78-80)

conflict_edge.note: Ordinary time-conception covers over originary temporality

tension_description: Within-time-ness is genuinely derived from originary temporality, yet it systematically conceals its own origin. Derivation + concealment.

dependency_edge.note: Projection is always thrown projection — never free-floating (§31)

tension_description: Dasein is simultaneously thrown (already-in) and projecting (ahead-of-itself). These are co-original moments of care that pull in opposite temporal directions.

dependency_edge.note: Dasein's existence is always factical — it is thrown into its 'there' (§§9, 29)

conflict_edge.note: Existence = possibility, to-be; facticity = thrownness, already-determined

tension_description: Dasein is its possibilities (existence) yet always already determined (facticity). Neither can be reduced to the other; their unity is care.

dependency_edge.note: Apophantical as-structure derives from hermeneutical as-structure (§33)

conflict_edge.note: Apophantical 'as' levels down the hermeneutical 'as' into mere predication

tension_description: Assertion depends on interpretation but transforms it. The logical tradition mistakes the derivative for the primordial.
